newsitem.title: UK: Big UK jobless falls will not last long - Forth.
newsitem.headline: Big UK jobless falls will not last long - Forth.

text.p: UK employment minister Eric Forth said on Wednesday special factors were partly behind the recent dramatic falls in unemployment and the big monthly drops will not continue for long.

"This is a temporary phase due to the transition of the job seekers' allowance which has given these figures a boost in the short term. The nearest we can come to is that about half of these figures we are giving each month are genuine falls in unemployment," he told RFTV in an interview.
Asked if an unemployment level of 6.0 percent was now in sight Forth said, "Yes I think it is."
Figures released earlier on Wednesday showed unemployment fell by 67,800 in January and the unemployment rate fell to 6.5 percent, the lowest rate for six years, from 6.7 percent in December.
